dataset_usage: Academic, non-commercial use; dataset redistribution is prohibited by its official source.

psnr_rgb.aggregation: per-image then arithmetic mean within subset

uciqe_lab.lightness_contrast: mean of largest k minus mean of smallest k, k=max(1,floor(N*0.01))

metrics.endpoint_definition: percentage of pixels with at least one RGB channel equal to the given 8-bit endpoint

interface.selection_rule: Highest mean SSIM, then mean PSNR, then lower strength.

selection.scope: UIEB/test/input and UIEB/test/GT from the authors’ published split
selection.method: seeded permutation of sorted candidates, first 40 with matching oriented dimensions and no exact C60 duplicate
all members other than the 10 development and 1 workflow files
